registration.why_it_matters: VAL-021, and nuclear heating is a quantity with no benchmark in the V&V matrix today.
registration.legacy_inventory: The older master branch of the same repository (commit c47fc573a7e2a9ca11a8958dc67155b1146adf51, layout before 2025-03-28) holds a CSG OpenMC model and an experiment.h5 for this experiment; develop deleted both (2025-03-28 and 2025-12-01) and the repository does not say where the measured values come from or under which terms they may be redistributed (the MIT licence of the repository covers its authors' own work, not third-party data). They are not registered here and no value from them is used.
registration.last_checked: 2026-10-14 against OFB develop at the pinned commit

normalisation.basis: OFB develop has no specification for this experiment, so no tally definition or normalisation exists to confirm.
normalisation.why: the case has no specification and no registered measured values
normalisation.next_step: register the specification and values, then confirm the normalisation from the original publication

uncertainty.note: No reference uncertainty exists because no reference value is registered.

compatibility.k_basis: authored default, to be reviewed when values exist

covariance.basis: no reference values and no calculation exist yet

nuclear_heating.description: nuclear heating measured along the shield depth (detector type, positions and unit not registered)
